title: Mercury feature tabs
description: Half-and-half feature section: a calm heading over a list of rows split by hairlines, the open row marked by a bright rule and a small pale-blue dot with its text and an underlined link. A tall rounded picture (art or mock UI) fills the other half and changes with the row; on phones it sits inside the open row.
notes: click a row to open it; without JavaScript the first row stays open
set mediaSide to start to put the picture on the left (alternate it down the page)
name: mercury-tabs

props.name: title
props.description: the heading over the list; pass a list of lines to choose the breaks

props.name: media
props.description: the picture used when a row has none of its own

props.name: mediaSide
props.description: which side the picture sits on from lg up

props.name: link
props.description: a link under the whole list, e.g. "Take the tour"

props.name: layout
props.description:
spread: heading at the top, list at the bottom of a tall column (beside portrait art) ·
grouped: heading and list together, centred beside the picture (beside a wide mock)
